title: Design System Contract: component contract
description: One JSON document describing the governed interface of exactly one component: identity, display name, typed props, slots, and states. Licensed Apache-2.0.

contractId.description: The contract's normative identity: the fold of the component's declared name (see the specification, section "The fold"). Lowercase letters and digits in hyphen-separated segments. Not namespaced and not versioned. Also a valid DSDS component id.

component.description: The design system's own display name for the component, carried verbatim. Never folded, and may differ from contractId.

exports.description: How code refers to this component: one record per way, so a tool can tell which usages this contract governs. Kinds are defined in the specification's Appendix B.

cemRef.description: Custom Elements Manifest identifier for this component. Carried as an identifier only; the manifest entry's shape is not restated here.

shadcnRef.description: shadcn registry item identifier for this component. Carried as an identifier only; the registry item's shape is not restated here.

slots.description: Named insertion points the component exposes. Optional. How a publisher obtains slot names is not specified.

states.description: Named conditions the component can be in. Optional. How a publisher obtains state names is not specified.

exportRecord.description: One way code refers to the component. kind selects the record's shape.

jsExport.description: A JavaScript export: the name a consumer imports and the exact module specifier it imports it from.

name.description: The exported name: the named export, or "default" for a default export. Not an aggregate ("*").

specifier.description: The module specifier exactly as a consumer writes it in an import, for example "@acme/ui" or "@acme/ui/button". One record per entry point.

customElementExport.description: A custom element tag name, as the Custom Elements Manifest records it.

tagName.description: A valid custom element name: lowercase, beginning with a letter, containing a hyphen.

angularSelectorExport.description: An Angular component or directive selector, verbatim as declared.

selector.description: The selector string exactly as the component declares it, for example "acme-button" or "button[acme-button], a[acme-button]".

props.description: The component's props, written as a JSON Schema 2020-12 object schema, so a stock validator can check a prop bag against it directly. Optional: a contract that omits props declares an empty, closed prop set. When props is present, additionalProperties is required and states whether undeclared props are allowed; closed is the expected value, and open is a deviation. An enum-typed prop is a variant axis; there is no separate variants member.

properties.description: Map from prop name to that prop's schema. A prop name is not empty.

required.description: Names of props a usage must supply. Every name must be a key of properties; the schema cannot check this, so a publisher checks it at publish.

additionalProperties.description: false: a prop outside properties is undeclared (closed). true: any prop is permitted (open), a deviation a publisher should explain in the contract's description.

prop.description: One prop's schema. type is required. default and every enum value must fit type, which allOf checks. If both enum and default are present, default must be one of the enum values; a publisher checks this at publish.

type.description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 type name, or an array of them.

default.description: The value used when a usage does not supply this prop. Any JSON value.

enum.description: The allowed values. A prop carrying enum is a variant axis.

deprecated.description: JSON Schema 2020-12's own deprecated annotation, carried as-is: true means a usage should stop supplying this prop. Say why or what replaces it in description.

slot.description: A slot, as a bare name or a record.

minChildren.description: The fewest children a usage must supply. 1 makes the slot required. Absent means 0. A publisher checks that minChildren does not exceed maxChildren.

maxChildren.description: The most children a usage may supply. 1 means only one. Absent means no limit. A run of text counts as one child.

accepts.description: The contractIds of the only components that may fill this slot. Absent means any component; empty means none. Every entry must be a contractId in the same manifest; a publisher checks this at publish.

allowsText.description: Whether text may fill this slot. Absent means true.

not.description: A slot with no components and no text could never be filled.

slotAccessibility.description: Accessibility requirements for a slot. Role and naming vocabulary are ARIA's.

required.description: Whether the slot's content must give the component an accessible name. Says nothing about whether the slot must be filled; minChildren says that.
